description: Native Codex studio hooks. Review and trust using /hooks; see .codex/docs/hooks-reference/hook-input-schemas.md.

hooks.command: bash -c 'studio_hook_root="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$studio_hook_root/.codex/hooks/run.sh" ]; do studio_hook_parent="$(dirname "$studio_hook_root")"; if [ "$studio_hook_parent" = "$studio_hook_root" ]; then printf "%s\n" "Studio hook entry point was not found above the session directory." >&2; exit 2; fi; studio_hook_root="$studio_hook_parent"; done; exec bash "$studio_hook_root/.codex/hooks/run.sh"'
